        'Per-task trade-offs are below; single-seed gains do not establish complementarity or additive utility.'
    ),

        'baseline-din',
        'g0-r0003-relation_content_counts',
        'g2-r0004-count_shrink',
        'g2-r0005-global_inclusive',
        'g2-r0005-band_inclusive',
        'g2-r0005-global_exclusive',
        'g2-r0005-band_exclusive',
    ],
    'topic': {
        'title': 'Compatibility of relation-content representation and history count shrinkage',
        'question': (
            'Under the frozen 100-event input and training protocol, can the two source approaches jointly '
            'improve four-task macro ROC-AUC over the stronger source at justified parameter and measured compute cost?'
        ),
        'hypothesis': (
            'Relation-content representation and count shrinkage may retain complementary history information, '
            'but overlapping statistics may make them redundant. A combination exceeding both frozen source bests '
            'under replacement and capacity controls, with repeat confirmation, would support added utility. '
            'Failure to exceed the stronger source, or gains explained by added capacity, would oppose that explanation '
            'for the tested implementation. Preserve the frozen information, scoring and training contracts; '
            'inspect implementation compatibility in the subsequent research phase.'
        ),
    },

    'task_tradeoffs': tradeoffs,
}
